title: Huang returned while the investigation continued
subtitle: Leadership changes and board oversight · November 2026
source: NVIDIA SEC filings and company announcements, November 2026

annotations.event: Huang resigns and Kress becomes interim CEO
annotations.context: Kress retains the CFO role. Harvey Jones becomes board chair.

annotations.event: NVIDIA announces a standing oversight committee
annotations.context: Its remit covers national security, export compliance and global trade risk.
NVIDIA’s SEC filing gives this as the effective date.

annotations.event: NVIDIA confirms the investigation will continue
annotations.context: A committee of independent directors retained independent counsel.
